designs.name: Instant Friends
designs.description: Warm ivory and pale gray doodle field with three tilted hand-drawn snapshot vignettes of Chiikawa, Hachiware, and Usagi along the lower portion.
designs.prompt: Create an original full-bleed wallpaper guided by the supplied reference set. Use reference image 2 for the pale repeating doodle field and tilted white snapshot-card composition, and references 1, 3, and 4 for Chiikawa, Hachiware, and Usagi. Render Chiikawa as a round white friend with tiny ears, dot eyes, tiny w mouth, and pink blush hatches; Hachiware as a white cat with a distinct powder-blue cap covering the head and ears, short whiskers, and pink cheek hatches; Usagi as a cream bunny with long upright pink-inner ears and a simple tiny face. Place three small tilted hand-drawn paper snapshots near the lower part, leaving the central schedule area quiet. No text, logos, UI controls, or watermarks.
